policy: Purposive pilot chosen from source-change descriptions before analyzer execution, not a random or representative accuracy sample. Three small public libraries provide string/HTML processing, signed serialization, and scheduling. Two commits per repository vary bug fixes and API/default behavior. Take each selected commit against its exact first parent (including two merge commits); retain the entire supported Python tree. Exclude changes outside Python runtime behavior, duplicate merge copies, unsupported licenses, or snapshots exceeding existing limits. No analyzer result is a selection criterion.
